list: Official 55 trophies — names, descriptions, grades and PSN targets verified live 2026-11-19 against Exophase and PSNProfiles; hidden flags from Output Lag's visible/hidden split (27 visible, 28 hidden). Guides are the author's own words; each cites its sources.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the roadmap in order — story first, then side stories, then activities and collectibles — and check the progress bar in this guide as you go. Nothing about it is missable on its own; it only waits on everything else. The whole platinum takes around 200 hours, so pace it rather than rushing the grind.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
Follow the roadmap in order: story, side stories, activities, collectibles.
Watch the progress bar here — this trophy pops on its own at the end.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the game's first mission and it teaches the basics, so just follow the on-screen objectives and finish it. The trophy pops as the mission completes — there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play, so there is no special trick: work through the chapter's missions and the trophy lands when the chapter ends (chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene). Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, because the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it pops as you play the story through — just complete the chapter's missions in order. Most of the list opens up once Jason and Lucia are both playable in this chapter, so use the new freedom to start side content, but the trophy itself only needs the chapter done.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions in order.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops when the chapter's missions are done. One thing to watch inside this chapter: the race against Yago in his street-racing strand is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks — save first, then race it the moment it appears, so the chapter trophy and the strand both stay on track.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order.
Do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears (hourglass icon).

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The chapter trophy pops as the story moves on, like the others before it. By now the robbery tools are arriving through optional and story missions, so the crime trophies start opening up too — but for this trophy, just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions in order.
Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is one of the two gold trophies, and it pops when the last mission ends. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a save is the only way to revisit the ending. Everything outside the story stays available after the credits, so the cleanup stages can wait until the story is done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Keep a manual save from just before the final mission.
Play the final mission through to the credits.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies unlock as the story reaches them — play the mission through and the trophy pops at the end. There is no side requirement; the mission itself is the whole task.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission Breakfast Run.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a named story mission, so it pops when you finish it — no extra objective, no collectible, just the heist itself played through to the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another named-mission trophy: reach the mission in the story, play it through, and the trophy pops when it ends. Keep your chapter saves current as you go, since missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission Child's Play.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy is the mission itself: get to it in the story order and finish it. No preparation helps more than showing up with full health and ammo, as with any big story set-piece.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission Headliners.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. It is worth remembering the airport's layout from this mission later — the Catch Me If You Can trophy sends you back to VCIA to steal a plane.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission trophies: finish the operation and it pops. With the story missions done, the roadmap moves on to side stories and free-roam cleanup.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Reach the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story — work you did earlier still counts toward it. The checklist covers story, stunts (300 for 100%, past the 250 the stunt trophy needs), challenges (70 of the 80), vehicles (200 of the 277 base models), all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations, and more. This is the long grind and the second gold trophy; treat the checklist as the plan and clear it stage by stage rather than chasing everything at once.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the story first — the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist line by line: stunts (300), challenges (70 of 80), vehicles (200 of 277), vaults (all 8), illegal operations (all 39).
Use the checklist itself as the plan; earlier progress still counts.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 unique stunts: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Stunts are counted per unique spot, so spread out across Leonida rather than repeating one jump. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past this trophy instead of stopping at 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Do stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps.
Spread out across Leonida — stunts count per unique spot.
Keep going to 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type the game offers at least once — the counter tracks 9 types, so dip into racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone racing and the gym as you meet them. It pops when the ninth type registers. Most types cross your path naturally while hunting other trophies, so check the counter before going out of your way.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Try one of each activity type as you meet it: racing, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone racing, gym and more.
Check the counter (9 types) after each new activity.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two shooting ranges. Learn each challenge's scoring first — gold needs clean, fast shooting, so practise a challenge until the pattern is familiar and then go for the medal run. Work through the list range by range and tick off the golds as they land.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Visit both shooting ranges.
Learn each challenge's scoring, then go for gold — clean, fast shooting.
Gold all 42 challenges between the two ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough; learn each course's corners before pushing for the win, and treat each location as its own small race rather than a grind. The counter tracks locations, so a win somewhere new is what moves it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win at least one race at each location.
Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as each win is at a different race — work through the race list rather than replaying a favourite. Street races, off-road and the rest all feed the same counter, so variety is the shortcut.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Work through the race list instead of replaying one favourite.
Win 20 races, each at a different race.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him: keep the line tension steady, reel when the fish tires, and do not rush the fight. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-fish him: steady tension, reel when the fish tires.
Challenge him again if you lose — one win is enough.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, play a full game to its end, and the trophy pops. Any cabinet counts, so pick a game you enjoy and finish it rather than quitting halfway.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find any arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to its end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger questlines — follow it to its last mission and finish it. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it needs finishing for its own trophy. Side-story finales stay open after the main story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Andy's stranger strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Andy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it — the trophy pops at the end of the finale. Like the other side-story finales, it stays open after the main story ends.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Kenton.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger questlines — follow it to its last mission and finish it. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for its own trophy; the finale stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Billy's stranger strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Billy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One time-sensitive strand race: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon) — save first, then race it the moment it appears, or that strand may be lost. Work the stranger map icons one by one and the counter will show which strands count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow stranger strands across Leonida — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do NOT count here.
Check the progress counter after each strand you finish.
Do Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, hourglass icon) the moment it appears — save first.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it. The finale stays open after the main story, so fold it into the side-story stage of the roadmap rather than rushing it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the stranger questlines — follow it to its last mission and finish it. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so it needs finishing for its own trophy; the finale stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.
Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE — read this first: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter ends. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the optional task. Do it while you are still in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. It is not fully confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that one spot, so do it anyway — it is the only meditation in the list known to vanish.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: IN CHAPTER 1: after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her to Jason's balcony to meditate — this spot vanishes after Chapter 1.
Keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
Meditate at the other 17 spots (purple icons when close), bringing your partner so outdoor spots count twice.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks — follow the questline until it points you at the unique animal, then take it down. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt rewards.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Bret Vogel's hunting questline (Jason-only) through its target decks.
Hunt the unique animal it points you at.
Take a clean head or heart shot to keep the carcass pristine.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you explore and track which sets are still missing; three finished sets pop the trophy. Sweep the map region by region during the cleanup stage so no set is left one card short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore Leonida.
Track which sets are still missing cards.
Complete any 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game app for tagging places — open it at landmarks and points of interest across the map and tag each new spot until the counter hits 100. It pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State, so tag as you sweep the map rather than making a separate trip for every location.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open the WAiNK app at landmarks and points of interest.
Tag each new location — 100 in total.
Combine it with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so this trophy pops on the way to the platinum if you keep an eye on the list. Many complete on their own while you play — check the list now and then and mop up the easy ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see the list.
Many complete on their own while you play — mop up the easy ones.
50 done pops the trophy; 70 of 80 are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest setup is a bank vault job, which hands you 4 stars at once — bring your partner, then break line of sight and leave the red heat zone. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area, so keep driving until you are fully clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Bring your partner along.
Get a 4-star Wanted Level — a bank vault job gives it at once.
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone completely.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and give it about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; the pop can be delayed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Call your partner, then pick three shops close together.
Rob all three in a row while the police are still chasing you.
Keep the Wanted Level alive the whole chain — if the stars fade, the chain breaks.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive; the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning past this trophy. Parked cars, traffic and rare spawns all count — make scanning a habit on every drive.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you drive — scanning counts as discovering.
100 vehicles pops the trophy; keep going to 200 of 277 for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle — Adrenaline extends Focus, so start the Focus with a full group in front of you and keep firing until all five are down.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a group of enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation.
Aim and press L3 + R3 to start Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the Focus ends — Adrenaline extends it.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work, while planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off; fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Save first — the police come fast.
At VCIA, steal a large plane docked at a boarding bridge (gates E3 and E4 work).
Back out to the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. The description is a joke about the tank's name, so the whole task is simply getting inside one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Save first.
Go to Mile Zero Air Station, far southwest island — tanks park on its south side.
Climb into a Rhino tank and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door — do not kick it in.
Find the safe-code note inside, open the safe, and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Each vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so keep going past the five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the optional mission That's Where The Money Is (late Chapter 4) to unlock vaults.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time; all 8 are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Wait for an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away — the trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area, so keep driving until you are fully clear. Trucks also show up around bank vault jobs, so this can pop while you work on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an armored truck on the road (or around a bank vault job).
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape — keep driving until you have left the red heat zone.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole map — the counter tracks 52 areas, so sweep the regions the story never takes you to, including the far corners and islands. It pairs with the WAiNK tagging and vehicle scanning trophies, so explore with those apps open and clear three counters in one sweep.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Sweep the whole map — 52 areas in total.
Cover regions the story never visits, including far corners and islands.
Explore with WAiNK open to tag locations and scan vehicles on the way.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way — just make sure at least one operation per gang is hit, and check the counter if a gang is missing. Illegal operations are the gang-run fronts scattered across Leonida; clear them as you find them rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find illegal operations across Leonida.
Rob at least one operation from each of the 9 gangs.
All 39 operations are needed for 100%, so this pops along the way.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission, so try the beachfront spots until it pops. The exact spot is not yet pinned down by any guide; work from the description and try the obvious beachfront bars first.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a beachfront bar and order a cocktail with a view.
Try the beachfront spots in turn until it pops — the exact spot is not yet pinned down.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass front and out the other side — pick a showroom with a clear exit line, build speed, and smash through. The exact showroom is not yet pinned down by any guide, so work from the description and try the big dealerships first. Save before the attempt in case the run goes wrong.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Save first.
Pick a vehicle showroom with a clear exit line.
Drive through the glass front and out the other side.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2 — bring Sticky Bombs, take the three key valuables (the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb), then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling (the Kolt & Associates alley) in Chapter 2 or later.
Bring Sticky Bombs; take the watch, the shotgun, and the office safe's contents.
Escape the police — left-behind valuables come back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you. Work on Strength steadily rather than in one sitting: train, rest, and train again until both characters are at maximum.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Buy a gym membership.
Train Strength with your partner alongside you.
Keep training until both Jason and Lucia reach maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the criminal life and check the counter now and then. If it is still short near the end, run a few more robberies and illegal operations; every criminal act pushes it along.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the criminal life: robberies, fights and illegal operations all feed it.
Check the counter (500) now and then.
If it is short near the end, run a few more robberies.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on the second try. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down by any guide; the description points at failing once and then succeeding, so if it has not popped, retry an activity you failed and finish it on the next attempt. Treat it as a trophy that finds you while you play rather than one to force.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Fail an activity once, then finish it on the next attempt.
If it has not popped, retry another activity you failed.
The exact trigger is not yet pinned down — it should find you while you play.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — witness something strange out in Leonida. The trigger is not yet pinned down by any guide; explore odd places and watch for an unusual event. Treat it as a late-game sweep trophy and check back once other guides confirm the spot — it is one of the few trophies this guide cannot yet pin to a place, and it says so plainly rather than guessing.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Explore odd places across Leonida and watch for an unusual event.
Leave it for the late-game sweep — the exact trigger is not yet pinned down.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past enemies on foot, strike them with a melee weapon from the moving vehicle — line up a slow pass through a group and swing as you go by. The name is a bowling joke; the trigger is the melee drive-by itself, so any slow drive past a group on foot should do it.

Just play normally and check the counter now and then; it rarely needs a dedicated grind.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count, so buy all eight from the app. Garages also give you the space to register cars for On the Spot, so buy them before that trophy.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register.
